correctness.rationale: Normalized Gegenbauer addition P_{d,4}(x·y) yields the N=d(d-1) Gram. Symmetric/antisymmetric sign-pair sectors give A=(d²-4)/(d²-1) with multiplicity C(d,2) and a Johnson J(2,d) block. Complete-graph unsigned incidence B*B=2I+J_1 decomposes the symmetric space into constant, vertex-standard and kernel edge sectors, giving B=(d-4)²(d+4)/(4(d²-1)), C=(d-8)²(d+2)/(8(d²-1)), D=3(d+2)(d+4)/(4(d²-1)) with multiplicities 1,d-1,d(d-3)/2. Only C vanishes at d8 (7-dimensional kernel); monotone rational branch analysis yields min positive eigenvalue 11/640 at d9, sharp optimal least-norm interpolation factor sqrt(640/11). Independently built Gram and checked full eigenspaces numerically d5..11, including seven zeros at d8.
residual_risks: This evaluation is exact harmonic degree 4, probability surface measure, antipodal representatives, not generic roots or all degrees.
